translationRepairs: Advance officers led the emperor into the small resting pavilion and lowered the curtain. When the Supreme Emperor had taken the throne, the curtain was raised. Advance officers led the emperor up the eastern steps to before the folding balustrade and requested that he bow. After the emperor bowed twice, they led him slightly forward to report on the Supreme Emperor's health, then led him back to bow twice again, and finally to stand west of the Supreme Emperor's throne, facing west.

Advance officers led the emperor into the small resting pavilion and lowered the curtain. When the Supreme Emperor had taken the throne, the curtain was raised. Advance officers led the emperor up the eastern steps to before the folding balustrade and requested that he bow. After the emperor bowed twice, they led him slightly forward to report on the Supreme Emperor's health, then led him back to bow twice again, and finally to stand east of the Supreme Emperor's throne, facing west.
s0078 ends 詣太上皇帝御坐之東，西向立: the emperor stands east of the Supreme Emperor's throne facing west; idiomatic "west of the ... throne" reverses 之東, and the proposed east correction matches the Chinese.
